title: 七上 · 校园生活训练卷
scope: 一般现在时、现在进行时、冠词与校园交际阅读；原创笔试能力训练。
language: g-present
Nina [[1]] the classroom door every morning.
opens
open
opening
every morning 表习惯，Nina 是第三人称单数，肯定句用 opens。
open 未体现本句第三人称单数。
opening 不能独立作这个一般现在时肯定句的谓语。
g-continuous
Listen! The children [[1]] in the next room.
are singing
sing
is singing
Listen 提醒正在发生，children 是复数，使用 are singing。
Listen 提示此刻正在发生，不是在描述一般习惯。
is 与复数主语 children 不一致。
g-articles
这里泛指一本指南：This is [[1]] useful guide to the school clubs.
a
an
the
useful 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，首次泛指一本指南用 a。
选 a 或 an 看发音；useful 并非以元音音素开头。
题目限定泛指一本，不是特指已确定的那本指南。
g-auxiliaries
Does your cousin [[1]] a dictionary to class?
bring
brings
brought
Does 已承担人称和时态，后面的动词用原形 bring。
不能在 Does 后再用第三人称单数形式 brings。
这里问一般现在的做法，不用过去式 brought。
g-adverbs
Please speak [[1]] so that everyone can hear the words.
clearly
clear
clearness
修饰 speak 这一动作，需要副词 clearly。
clear 在这里不能替代修饰 speak 所需的副词。
clearness 是名词，不能这样修饰 speak。
g-question-words
'[[1]] is the new art room?' 'On the second floor.'
Where
When
Who
答句提供位置，疑问词用 Where。
When 问时间，不对应楼层位置。
Who 问人，不对应房间位置。
g-reflexives
I can carry this small box by [[1]].
myself
herself
themselves
by myself 表示我独自完成，与 I 一致。
herself 指她自己，与 I 不一致。
themselves 指他们自己，与 I 不一致。
g-there-be
There [[1]] three notices on the board.
are
is
be
three notices 是复数，存在句用 There are。
is 与复数名词 notices 不一致。
be 不能独立作这里一般现在时的限定谓语。

cloze.text: Every Thursday, our class has a short reading break. At first I always choose the 〔1〕_____ book because I think finishing many pages is the only goal. Then my friend shows me a book about birds. It has fewer pages, but I want to understand every picture. I begin to ask 〔2〕_____ about the birds near our school. I write them in a notebook. During the next break, I look for the 〔3〕_____ instead of counting pages. Sometimes I cannot find one, so I ask the librarian for another book. Reading is 〔4〕_____ now because I have something I want to know. My notebook is still small, but each question gives me a 〔5〕_____ to read again.
items: longest
shortest
cheapest
I think finishing many pages is the only goal.
最初只把读很多页当目标，所以选页数最多、最长的书。
shortest 与最初追求很多页的目标不符。
原文没有比较价格，不能由阅读页数推出 cheapest。
questions
prices
tickets
I write them in a notebook.
后文 each question 回指这里记录的问题。
prices 是价格，文章讨论的是想了解鸟的问题。
tickets 是票，与阅读求知情境无关。
answers
covers
chairs
Sometimes I cannot find one, so I ask the librarian for another book.
前面记录问题，这里在书中寻找答案。
封面不能回答笔记中的问题。
椅子不是这里通过读书寻找的内容。
interesting
impossible
finished
I have something I want to know.
有自己想了解的事，阅读变得有意思。
impossible 表不可能，与继续找书阅读不符。
finished 表结束，与最后 read again 的持续阅读不符。
reason
price
page
each question
每个问题都给继续阅读一个理由。
price 是价格，不是继续阅读的动机。
问题可以带来阅读的理由，不能据此说它产生了一页纸。

reading.text:
TRY A CLUB AFTERNOON
Students can try two clubs this Friday. The music club meets in Room 3 from 3:30 to 4:00. You can use the drums there; you do not need your own. The garden club meets by the east gate from 4:15 to 4:45. Bring a notebook, but leave large bags in your classroom. You may join both sessions because they happen at different times. Write your name on the list outside Room 3 before Thursday lunchtime. Trying a club does not mean you must join it for the whole term.
items: What does a student need for the garden session?
A notebook.
A drum.
A large bag.
Bring a notebook, but leave large bags in your classroom.
园艺体验需要笔记本，且大包留教室。
鼓是音乐社团的设备，不是园艺体验的物品。
大包明确要求留在教室。
Why can a student try both clubs?
Their sessions are at different times.
They are in the same room.
Each session lasts a whole term.
You may join both sessions because they happen at different times.
原文直接给出时间不冲突这一原因。
音乐在3号教室，园艺在东门，并非同一地点。
一次体验与整个学期的参加是两回事。
When must students put their names on the list?
Before Thursday lunchtime.
After Friday's garden session.
At 4:45 on Friday.
before Thursday lunchtime.
报名截止要求是周四午餐前。
活动结束后报名晚于规定时间。
4:45是园艺活动结束时间，不是报名截止。
What is true about trying a club?
Students may decide later whether to join for the term.
It commits students to the club for the term.
Students must bring their own drums.
Trying a club does not mean you must join it for the whole term.
体验不等于必须参加整学期，可以随后作决定。
must join 与原文 does not mean ... must join 相反。
音乐社团提供鼓，无需自带。

reading.text: When Leo draws a picture, he often starts again after one small mistake. His sister gives him a new notebook. On its first page she writes, 'Keep one thing that does not look right.' Leo thinks this is a strange rule. He draws a house, but one window is too low. Instead of tearing out the page, he draws a flower box under that window. At the end of the week, he has five complete pictures. They are not perfect, but he can see what he is learning. He decides to keep the notebook and the strange rule.
items: What does Leo usually do after a small mistake at first?
Starts again.
Finishes five pictures at once.
Gives the notebook away.
he often starts again after one small mistake.
开头交代他遇到小错就重来。
五幅完成图是改变做法后一周的结果。
文中说他最后保留笔记本，没有送出。
How does Leo use the low window in his picture?
He adds a flower box under it.
He tears out the page.
He moves his real house.
he draws a flower box under that window.
他把画中的低窗利用为添加花箱的地方。
tear out 是他没有采用的做法。
house 是画中的房子，不是搬动现实住房。
Why does Leo probably keep the strange rule?
It helps him finish work and notice his learning.
It makes every picture perfect.
It tells him never to change anything.
They are not perfect, but he can see what he is learning.
结合完成五幅画与看到进步，可推断新规则有帮助。
原文明示作品并非完美。
保留一次不理想的细节，不等于永远不能修改任何内容。
Which title best fits the story?
A useful place for a mistake
How to build a real house
Five ways to buy notebooks
Keep one thing that does not look right.
故事围绕接纳小错并继续创作，不是买东西或建筑。
实际内容是画画和学习方式，并非造房子。
只出现姐姐赠送一本笔记本，没有五种购买方法。

task.text:
WALKING GROUP
Our lunchtime walking group meets on Monday and Wednesday. Meet outside the library at 12:30. We walk for fifteen minutes and return before afternoon lessons. Bring water. There is no fee. If heavy rain is expected, the organiser will put a change notice on the classroom board before lunch. Read that notice before leaving your room.
items: The group meets outside the _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
library
Meet outside the library at 12:30.
图书馆外是集合点；教室板报是查通知的位置。
The walk lasts _____ minutes. 填阿拉伯数字。
We walk for fifteen minutes
fifteen 是持续时间，不是12:30这一开始钟点。
Before leaving the room, students should read a change _____ if rain is expected. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
notice
Read that notice before leaving your room.
大雨预报时先看变更通知，空格应填 notice。

writing.stem: 写一封约50—70词的英文邮件，邀请交换生参加周一的午间散步。说明12:30在图书馆外集合、散步15分钟、自带水，并提醒午餐前查看是否有天气变更通知。请对方回复是否参加。名字可虚构。
writing.model:
Hi Alex,
Would you like to join our lunchtime walk on Monday? We will meet outside the library at half past twelve and walk for fifteen minutes. Please bring some water. Before lunch, check the classroom board for a change notice if rain is expected. Let me know if you can come. I hope we can walk together.
Best wishes,
Lin
points: 周一12:30在图书馆外集合，散步15分钟
午餐前查天气变更通知
writing.organisation: 先邀请，再交代活动与准备，最后提出回复请求。
writing.language: 区分开始钟点与持续时间；检查 will 后的动词原形和礼貌请求。
writing.pitfall: 不要把15分钟写成15点，也不要漏掉天气变更的提醒。
